### How We're Different

URL: https://www.ingenious.build/ingenious-vs-procore-mcp
Section: Product

INGENIOUS Pro's native MCP server gives any AI live access to your full project data — not just one account. See how it beats Procore's Datagrid AI.

Native MCP AI: ING VS Procore

How We're Different

AI is only as good as the data it can see — and which data it can see depends entirely on how the platform was built.

Procore's AI runs through Datagrid as a separate purchase, reading only what lives inside a single account.

INGENIOUS.BUILD's native MCP server connects your AI directly to structured data across every workspace connected to yours — included in INGENIOUS Pro.

Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or any MCP-compatible AI via OAuth 2.0.

Native MCP Server

Built for the whole project, not one company's account.

Procore and Datagrid are confined to a single instance — one company's data, one company's account. INGENIOUS.BUILD gives every party on a project — owner, developer, GC, architect, engineer, sub, vendor — its own private workspace. Those workspaces connect on shared projects, routing live structured data between parties rather than attachments. Every party controls their own data. What's shared between them is what the AI can read.

Connected Workspaces. Intelligent Outcomes.

Every workspace includes a native MCP server allowing AI agents to work directly from live project data instead of uploaded files. AI can access only the information that has been intentionally shared.

**No manual uploads. No blind spots.**

Private by default. Connected by design.

Five Questions Every Buyer Asks

INGENIOUS.BUILD vs Procore

How the two platforms answer the questions that matter on a live project.

Procore (with Datagrid)

INGENIOUS.BUILD Native MCP

Procore project data is company/account-based. Datagrid reads data inside the account of the company that purchased it — no one else's. Even if every party on your project uses Procore, each one runs a separate instance that Datagrid cannot see into. Data that moves between them — drawings, RFIs, invoices — still travels as attachments that have to be manually uploaded before the AI can read them. Manual uploads introduce lag — and on a live project, by the time the AI sees it, the data may already be stale. Stale data isn't a delay — it's untracked risk. Procore's 100+ connectors stitch one company's internal tech stack — they don't connect between companies on a project.

Connected workspaces, AI-ready by design. On INGENIOUS when data is shared between workspaces it arrives instantly as live structured data — not an attachment waiting to be uploaded. The native MCP server connects Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or any MCP-compatible AI directly to your workspace data the moment it's shared, reading across every connected workspace you have access to. No delay. No gap for risk to live in. Private by default. Connected by design.

Digital Coworker package required. Admin-gated. Projects must be indexed. Getting Datagrid AI running requires a Procore Digital Coworker package, a Company Admin to enable it, and individually indexing each project to unlock project-specific answers and agentic actions. Once a project is selected and indexed for Procore AI, Procore currently states that it cannot be undone.

User-permissioned. No new access surface. The native MCP server inherits the user's existing role, workspace, and record-level permissions. The AI sees exactly what the user sees in the UI — nothing more. Revoke a user's access and the AI loses it the same second.

Digital Coworker package. Credit-based at scale. Requires a Procore Digital Coworker package. Pro and Enterprise use shared AI credit pools. AI questions, agent tasks, data ingestion, storage, syncing, and background processes consume credits.

Included in INGENIOUS Pro. The native MCP server ships with the platform. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or any MCP-compatible AI and use it as much as your team needs — the price doesn't change.

Procore AI + connected Datagrid environment. Procore AI is embedded in the Procore side panel and is provisioned with a connected Datagrid environment. Users can choose models such as Claude, GPT, or Gemini, while Datagrid provides the AI infrastructure, indexing, agents, and connection to Procore data.

Native MCP server, first-party. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or another MCP-compatible AI tool directly to INGENIOUS.BUILD via OAuth 2.0. The MCP server connects INGENIOUS.BUILD data and capabilities without requiring a separate AI orchestration product between the platform and the AI.

Generally available. Procore AI is available through Digital Coworker Starter, Pro, and Enterprise packages.

Available today across the full project lifecycle. Live in production via the native MCP server — across schedule, budget, RFIs, submittals, contracts, change orders, invoices, and meetings.

Why This Matters

The AI advantage is only as real as the data behind it.

Better Answers, Full Project

When your AI has the full picture — not just your company's fragment — it catches risk before it becomes a problem. Earlier signals, sharper recommendations, decisions you can stand behind.

Construction moves fast and coordination failures are expensive. When every party works on the same live project data, approvals happen in real time, responses don't get lost in inboxes, and nothing stalls because someone forgot to forward a file.

Secure by Inheritance

The native MCP server respects every user's existing role, workspace, and record-level permissions. The AI sees exactly what the user sees in the UI — nothing more. No new access surface to govern. Revoke a user's access and the AI loses it the same second.

The native MCP server is included in INGENIOUS Pro. No per-use credit consumption. No surprise bills when your team starts using AI more. Connect whichever model you use and run it as much as you want — the price doesn't change.

### QuickBooks Construction Integration

URL: https://www.ingenious.build/integrations/quickbooks
Section: Integrations

Sync QuickBooks with INGENIOUS.BUILD for construction accounting. Automate cost tracking, eliminate double entry and see project financials in real time.

INGENIOUS.BUILD and Quickbooks Online Integration

Why INGENIOUS.BUILD & Quickbooks Online?

Centralize your project management and accounting information to reduce time spent navigating multiple systems and create a more streamlined workflow.

Time and Cost Savings

Automating data transfer saves significant time previously spent on manual data entry and verification, reducing overall administrative costs.

Manual data entry often introduces human error. Automating data sync ensures far greater accuracy and reliability across both systems.

Better Vendor Management

Synchronizing vendor data across systems enhances management of vendor relationships—from contract negotiation to payment—boosting overall efficiency in vendor management.

Shared access to information enables real-time communication between teams, fostering a more collaborative and efficient work environment.

Improved Decision- Making

Access to real-time, synchronized information enables more informed and timely decision-making.

How it works?

Once the integration is established and fields are mapped between INGENIOUS.BUILD and QuickBooks Online, approved invoices sync from INGENIOUS.BUILD to QuickBooks Online Bills straight away. When a bill is paid in QuickBooks Online, the invoice status in INGENIOUS.BUILD updates automatically, within 4 hours.

Accounting Cost Codes

Products and Services (Items)

Chart Of Accounts

Q: Are you adding more functionality to this integration? A: We are continuously evaluating and adding new fields to our integrations. If you have a critical field you need added in order to make this integration function, please reach out to our Integrations team at integrations@ingenious.build.

Q: How often does the integration process information? A: Invoices sync to QuickBooks Online as soon as they're approved in INGENIOUS.BUILD. Payment status and company vendors are pulled in from QuickBooks Online every 4 hours.

Q: Are there any notable unsupported items with this integration? A: Tax Categories, General Ledgers, Projects, Purchase Orders, and Materials Tracking are not supported by this integration.

Q: Will the integration sync previous project data? A: Companies and Cost Codes can be linked between INGENIOUS.BUILD and QuickBooks Online® regardless of their start date; however, only new invoices will sync.

### I. How our Service Works

Ingenious provides a unique online service which is designed to allow our Customers and their Authorized Users (as these terms are defined below) to access our Services via the Internet on a subscription ‘software as a service’ (SaaS) basis.
